plan_name: GloBird ZEROHERO Residential (Flexible Rate) United Energy

free_windows.name: Perfect if you love free stuff

conditions: Offer ID GLO764999MR; distributor United Energy; Climate Zone 6; release date 2026-07-01.
You must have installed an eligible battery and solar-PV.
You must have an eligible smart meter.

This offer is for VIC residential customers who have a Qualifying System and must meet and remain compliant with the Eligibility Criteria and all other requirements of the Virtual Power Plant Terms and Conditions.

APPROXIMATED - Super Export Credit is 10c/kWh on the FIRST 15 kWh of exports 6pm-9pm daily (inclusive of other feed-in tariffs). The 15 kWh/day windowed cap is not representable in the schema, so export beyond 15 kWh within 6pm-9pm is over-credited at 10c instead of dropping to the 2c peak feed-in.
NOT MODELLED - ZEROHERO Credit: $1/day when imports are 0.03 kWh/hour or less between 6pm-9pm (behavioural daily credit, not a usage/FiT rate).

NOT MODELLED - Critical Peak-Export Credit ($1/kWh on export) and Critical Peak-Import Credit (5c/kWh on import): dispatched at the retailer's discretion during critical-peak events and require 5-minute interval data; event timing is unknown so both are excluded.
